items.name: error-boundary
items.title: NocoBase Error Boundary
items.description: Reusable render boundaries and NocoBase runtime status views with copyable redacted diagnostics and recovery actions.
items.docs: Uses react-error-boundary for render containment and provides runtime status UI for original NocoBase gateway and account error codes. It contributes only a development showcase at /dev/error-boundary, with no production routes, providers, or menu entries.

items.name: route-surfaces
items.title: NocoBase Route Surfaces
items.description: URL-backed drawer, dialog, and page containers with nested drawer stacking and a shared close lifecycle.
items.docs: Provides presentation containers plus an integrated Demo and Prompt generator. Route definitions, ACL guards, data fetching, and business content remain application-owned.

items.name: client
items.title: NocoBase Client Components
items.description: Small reusable Portal client components with transport-agnostic APIs and shadcn UI composition.
items.docs: Provides dependency-light client components without NocoBase resource or Refine coupling. RemoteSelect delegates data access to a caller-provided loadOptions function and contributes only a development showcase under /dev/client/remote-select.

items.name: users-example
items.title: NocoBase Users Example
items.description: Complete Users resource example with ACL-aware list, filters, route-backed drawers, nested role details, and optional AI page context.
items.docs: Requires the compatible Portal Starter resource components, data table, NocoBase data provider, and ACL provider. AI page-element and form registration is enabled automatically when @nocobase/ai is also installed.

items.name: i18n
items.title: NocoBase i18n
items.description: Optional NocoBase server-language resources, user preference persistence, reusable language controls, and an integrated showcase for the Portal SDK i18n runtime.
items.docs: Requires a compatible Portal SDK i18n and System Settings runtime plus the template's AppExtension Provider/UserMenuItems host fields. The Registry reuses cached systemSettings:get data and calls app:getLang only for registered dynamic namespaces such as lm-collections.

items.name: auth-oidc
items.title: NocoBase OIDC Authentication
items.description: Dynamic OIDC sign-in adapter, headless sign-in hook, and integrated component demo.
items.docs: Requires the Starter authentication runtime and an enabled OIDC authenticator in NocoBase. The default UI is discovered automatically and can be replaced per authentication type or authenticator instance from the application login page.

items.name: auth-saml
items.title: NocoBase SAML Authentication
items.description: Dynamic SAML sign-in adapter, automatic redirect provider, headless hook, and integrated demo.
items.docs: Requires the Starter authentication runtime and an enabled SAML authenticator in NocoBase.

items.name: auth-cas
items.title: NocoBase CAS Authentication
items.description: Dynamic CAS sign-in adapter, headless sign-in hook, and integrated component demo.
items.docs: Requires the Starter authentication runtime and an enabled CAS authenticator in NocoBase.

items.name: auth-ldap
items.title: NocoBase LDAP Authentication
items.description: Dynamic LDAP account/password form, headless sign-in hook, and integrated component demo.
items.docs: Requires the Starter authentication runtime and an enabled LDAP authenticator in NocoBase.

items.name: auth-sms
items.title: NocoBase SMS Authentication
items.description: Dynamic SMS verification-code form, delivery countdown, headless hook, and integrated demo.
items.docs: Requires the Starter authentication runtime, an enabled SMS authenticator, and a configured public SMS verifier in NocoBase.

items.name: auth-wecom
items.title: NocoBase WeCom Authentication
items.description: Dynamic WeCom sign-in adapter, browser automatic login, headless hook, and integrated demo.
items.docs: Requires the Starter authentication runtime and an enabled WeCom authenticator in NocoBase.

items.name: auth-dingtalk
items.title: NocoBase DingTalk Authentication
items.description: Dynamic DingTalk sign-in adapter, automatic login, headless hook, and integrated demo.
items.docs: Requires the Starter authentication runtime and an enabled DingTalk authenticator in NocoBase. DingTalk JSAPI is loaded lazily for internal micro-app login.

items.name: ai-runtime
items.title: NocoBase AI Runtime
items.description: NocoBase AI services, providers, transports, controllers, and avatars.

items.name: ai-chat
items.title: NocoBase AI Chat Components
items.description: Reusable NocoBase AI chat window, containers, floating trigger, and employee shortcut.

items.name: ai-react-hook-form
items.title: NocoBase AI React Hook Form Adapter
items.description: Optional React Hook Form adapter for the built-in AI Form filler.

items.name: ai
items.title: NocoBase AI Components and Demo
items.description: Complete NocoBase AI component runtime with application resources, routes, and component showcase pages.
items.docs: This item includes the AI extension integration and Demo pages. It is designed for a compatible starter with the AppExtension host enabled. After installation, src/extensions/nocobase-ai/extension.tsx is discovered automatically and contributes its application resources and routes without AI-specific App.tsx edits.

items.name: file-upload
items.title: NocoBase File Upload
items.description: Controlled shadcn/ui file upload field for NocoBase file collections.
items.docs: Requires a compatible Portal SDK client and a field targeting a file-template collection. The extension contributes a development-only file manager at /dev/files; its public-URL preview gallery does not require attachments:list.

items.name: mail
items.title: NocoBase Mail
items.description: Mail inbox, compose, detail, and label components backed by the NocoBase mail API.
items.docs: Requires a compatible Portal SDK and a NocoBase server with the mail plugin enabled. The mail API adapter uses the authenticated SDK client.

items.name: acl-ui
items.title: NocoBase ACL UI
items.description: Page, region, field, and role-switching components backed by the Starter's NocoBase accessControlProvider.
items.docs: Requires a compatible NocoBase Starter with the built-in accessControlProvider and ACL store.

items.name: acl
items.title: NocoBase ACL Components and Demo
items.description: Complete ACL composition demo with live role switching, action matrix, multi-collection regions, and field permissions.
